WITH per_order AS (
  SELECT ordersmark, AVG(fillcount) AS avg_fill_size
  FROM orderexecutions
  GROUP BY ordersmark
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS overall_avg
  FROM per_order
), first_pass AS (
  SELECT p.ordersmark, p.avg_fill_size,
         p.avg_fill_size - b.overall_avg AS margin_over_overall
  FROM per_order AS p
  CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
  WHERE p.avg_fill_size > b.overall_avg
), group_benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS first_pass_avg
  FROM first_pass
), final_orders AS (
  SELECT f.avg_fill_size, f.margin_over_overall,
         f.avg_fill_size - g.first_pass_avg AS margin_over_first_pass
  FROM first_pass AS f
  CROSS JOIN group_benchmark AS g
  WHERE f.avg_fill_size > g.first_pass_avg
)
SELECT AVG(avg_fill_size) AS avg_per_order_fill_size,
       AVG(margin_over_overall) AS avg_margin_over_first_benchmark,
       AVG(margin_over_first_pass) AS avg_margin_over_second_benchmark
FROM final_orders

assumptions.assumption: The overall benchmark is the unweighted average of per-order average fill sizes, counting NULL ordersmark values as one group, as requested by grouping executions with no order reference together. Margin means the arithmetic difference between an order's average fill size and the relevant benchmark.
